prices.metaDescription: Transparent pricing at Nova Taxi – fair estimates for rides in Central Switzerland and to the airports.
prices.subtitle: Prices
prices.title: Fair prices with clear communication.
prices.description: Every ride is individual – yet transparency in costs is important. That's why we inform you about the expected price before the ride and consider distance, time of day and special requests.
factors: Waiting at destination or intermediate stops
prices.inquiryDescription: The easiest way is a short inquiry with start, destination, date, time and number of passengers. We'll give you a clear estimate before you book.

contact.responseNote: We'll get back to you as soon as possible with a response or price estimate.

aboutUs.metaDescription: Nova Taxi – modern taxi service from Central Switzerland focused on punctuality, comfort and personal service.
aboutUs.subtitle: About Us
aboutUs.title: Nova Taxi – on the road for you in Central Switzerland.
aboutUs.description: Behind Nova Taxi is a personal, owner-operated taxi service with years of experience. Our goal: rides you can rely on – whether for everyday life, special occasions or important business trips.
aboutUs.regionalDescription: Nova Taxi is at home in Central Switzerland – with a focus on Arth-Goldau, Lucerne, Zug and the surrounding communities. We know the region, the routes and the typical transportation needs of our customers.

airportTransfer.metaDescription: Direct airport transfer with Nova Taxi – punctual, comfortable and plannable. Rides to Zurich and Basel airports from Central Switzerland.
airportTransfer.subtitle: Airport Transfer
airportTransfer.title: Relaxed airport transfers for your travels.
airportTransfer.description: With Nova Taxi, you start your vacation or business trip stress-free. We pick you up on time at home, at the hotel or office and take you directly to Zurich or Basel airports – no detours and with plenty of space for your luggage.
airportTransfer.expectationsTitle: What to expect from our airport transfer:
expectations: Punctual pickup – even early morning or late evening
Rides to Zurich and Basel airports
Comfortable vehicles with ample storage space
Fixed meeting points at train station, hotel or business address
Round-trip planning available in advance on request
airportTransfer.bookingDescription: For a non-binding offer or direct booking, simply call us or send us your flight details by email.
airportTransfer.bookingNote: Please include pickup location, date, time and number of passengers in your inquiry – so we can quickly provide you with a suitable offer.

business.metaDescription: Business rides with Nova Taxi – discreet, punctual and professional. Rides to meetings, hotels and events throughout Central Switzerland.
business.subtitle: Business Rides
business.title: Discreet rides for business and corporate clients.
business.description: Whether important meeting, hotel transfer or event – Nova Taxi ensures you and your guests arrive punctually and in style. Discreet, reliable and tailored to your needs.
business.useCasesTitle: Ideal for companies, agencies and hotels:
useCases: Rides to meetings, seminars and conferences
Hotel transfers for guests and business partners
Chauffeur services for events and corporate functions
Planning of recurring rides as needed
business.offerDescription: For regular rides or special requirements, we're happy to create an individual offer. Contact us with the key details – we'll get back to you quickly.
business.offerNote: Consolidated invoicing and dedicated contacts available on request.

courier.metaDescription: Courier services with Nova Taxi – secure and direct delivery of important documents, records and shipments in Central Switzerland.
courier.subtitle: Courier & Special Services
courier.title: When it's important, Nova Taxi delivers personally.
courier.description: For urgent documents, medical records or time-sensitive deliveries, a standard courier service is often too slow or inflexible. With Nova Taxi, your shipments are delivered personally and directly.
courier.inquiryDescription: Briefly describe what needs to be transported, from where to where and by when. We'll get back to you with a concrete proposal.
courier.inquiryNote: All shipments are treated confidentially and transported directly – without reloading.
